inputs.original_text: US-Israel-Iran War Amid escalating Middle East tensions the US proposed a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran via Pakistan Iran however presented five counter-conditions seeking an end to aggression compensation and recognition of Strait of Hormuz sovereignty Israel remains sceptical of Irans acceptance and emphasises its right to pre-emptive strikes highlighting the complex demands from all sides to end the ongoing conflict
inputs.modified_text:
Open your eyes, people. They want you to believe this is just standard diplomacy, but it is all theater orchestrated by the hidden puppet masters running these global institutions. 

Look at what they are really admitting out in the open. The US supposedly pushes a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran via Pakistan, while Iran comes back with five counter-conditions seeking an end to aggression, compensation, and recognition of Strait of Hormuz sovereignty. This is not a genuine breakdown in talks; it is a meticulously scripted division of labor designed to keep the conflict narrative alive for the elites' control grid. 

And then notice how Israel conveniently remains sceptical of Iran's acceptance and emphasises its right to pre-emptive strikes. That skepticism is the exact cover they need to keep the gears turning and justify the next phase of their coordinated manipulation. They are playing their assigned roles to perfection, pretending to have complex demands while executing a unified agenda behind the scenes. Nothing you are being told by official channels is true.
